Access.title: Team and roles
Access.description: The newsroom's accounts and the roles that define what each may do in the panel.
Access.usersDescription: Each account signs in with its own e-mail and signs news with its own name.
Access.rolesDescription: A role is a set of permissions. The four system roles may gain permissions but never lose their originals.
Access.name: Name
Access.emailFixed: The sign-in e-mail never changes; for another e-mail, create a new account.
Access.newUserHelp: The account gets a temporary password, shown once, and replaces it with a definitive one at first access.
Access.selfHelp: You cannot change your own role or disable your own account.
Access.enabledHelp: Disabled, the account can no longer sign in and its sessions end; the news it signs stay online.
Access.bioHelp: Shown on the author's page on the site.
Access.removePhotoWarning: {name}'s photo will be deleted and the initials will show again.
Access.newPasswordWarning: {name}'s current password stops working and open sessions end. The new password is shown only once.

systemDescriptions.admin: Full control of the portal, including team, roles and integrations.
systemDescriptions.editor: Edits and publishes any news item, runs the front page, sections and media.
systemDescriptions.reporter: Writes their own news and sends them to review.
systemDescriptions.reviewer: Reviews and corrects any news item, without publishing.

Access.systemRoleHelp: System role: name and description are fixed, and the original permissions stay checked.
Access.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {no account} one {# account} other {# accounts}}
Access.deleteWarning: The role {name} will be deleted. Only roles without accounts can be deleted.

errors.email_taken: An account with this e-mail already exists.
errors.role_system: System roles keep their name and description and cannot be deleted.
errors.role_baseline: System roles cannot lose their original permissions.
errors.role_in_use: This role still has accounts. Change their role before deleting it.
errors.access_lockout: At least one enabled account must keep the "Team and roles" permission.
errors.role_not_found: The chosen role no longer exists.
errors.user_disabled: Disabled accounts cannot get a temporary password: enable the account first.

news_read.label: Read news
news_read.description: Sees every news item in the panel, in any status, and the overview.

news_write.label: Write news
news_write.description: Creates news and edits its own while they are drafts or in review.

news_edit_all.label: Edit any news
news_edit_all.description: Edits news by any author, published ones included (corrections), and changes the byline.

news_publish.label: Publish
news_publish.description: Publishes, schedules, unpublishes and archives news.

news_delete.label: Delete news
news_delete.description: Deletes news that are not published.

taxonomy_manage.label: Sections and tags
taxonomy_manage.description: Creates, edits, orders and removes sections and tags.

media_manage.label: Media
media_manage.description: Uploads, describes, generates with AI and removes library images.

ai_use.label: Use AI
ai_use.description: Uses the AI writer and the builder's automatic translation.

front_page_manage.label: Front page
front_page_manage.description: Chooses the headline, highlights and sections of the home page.

themes_manage.label: Themes and branding
themes_manage.description: Creates and activates themes and replaces logos, favicons and the share image.

site_manage.label: Site details
site_manage.description: Edits the site's name, description, social profiles and legal texts.

contacts_read.label: Readers' messages
contacts_read.description: Reads and organizes the messages sent through the contact form.

users_manage.label: Team and roles
users_manage.description: Creates accounts, issues temporary passwords and defines roles and permissions.

settings_manage.label: Integrations
settings_manage.description: Configures artificial intelligence and e-mail (SMTP) and views storage.

audit_read.label: Audit
audit_read.description: Reads the record of everything each account did in the panel.

documentation_read.label: Documentation
documentation_read.description: Reads the project's technical documentation published in the panel.

Access.forbiddenDescription: Your role does not include this area. Ask whoever manages the team to adjust your permissions.

AiSettings.title: Artificial intelligence
AiSettings.description: The model provider of automatic translation, the AI writer and generated images.

codes.ai_unconfigured: No key configured: enter a Gemini key or choose the local provider (development only).
codes.ai_provider_failed: The provider did not answer. Try again in a moment.
codes.ai_key_rejected: The provider refused the key. Check the saved key.
codes.ai_images_unavailable: Image generation is off or the provider has no image model.

AiSettings.localNotice: The local provider uses no language model: it marks translations with [EN]/[PT], builds drafts from the request's own text and draws abstract covers. It lets you test every flow at no cost.

test.ok: The provider answered: the configuration works.

AiSettings.providerHelp: Automatic uses Gemini when a key exists and, without one, the local provider (outside production only).
AiSettings.apiKeyKept: A key is saved: leave blank to keep it.
AiSettings.apiKeyHelp: Write-only: once saved, the key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
AiSettings.apiKeyEnvironment: The server also has a key (GEMINI_API_KEY); the one saved here takes precedence.
AiSettings.imageModelHelp: "gemini-*-image" or "imagen-*" models. Blank uses the default shown.
AiSettings.imagesHelp: Lets the AI writer and the media library generate cover images.
AiSettings.guidelinesHelp: Goes into every AI request (translation, writing, images): tone, preferred terms, spellings, what to avoid.
AiSettings.guidelinesPlaceholder: E.g. Lowercase "president". Avoid adjectives. Spell out dates. In English, American spelling.
AiSettings.providerSectionHelp: Who answers translation, writing and image requests.
AiSettings.guidelinesSectionHelp: The rules the AI follows to write like the newsroom.
AiSettings.privacyNote: The AI receives only each request's text and the style guide; never accounts, passwords or readers' messages.

errors.keyRequired: The Gemini provider needs a key (saved here or on the server).
errors.keyInvalid: The key looks invalid: check it was copied whole, without spaces.

EmailSettings.title: E-mail (SMTP)
EmailSettings.description: The portal's outgoing e-mail: the notice of a new reader message to the contact address, and the test.
EmailSettings.missingNotice: Sending is on but there is no server: configure one below or the server's SMTP_* variables.

test.ok: Test e-mail sent to your account.

codes.smtp_unreachable: could not connect and authenticate to the server.

EmailSettings.enabledHelp: Off, no e-mail leaves the portal; readers' messages stay in the panel.
EmailSettings.secureHelp: On for port 465; off for 587, 25 and 2525.
EmailSettings.passwordKept: A password is saved: leave blank to keep it.
EmailSettings.passwordHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
EmailSettings.sendingSectionHelp: Turns every e-mail of the portal on or off.
EmailSettings.serverSectionHelp: Without a server here, the portal uses the environment's (SMTP_*), if any.

errors.invalid: Check the server, the port (465 with TLS; 587, 25 or 2525 without), the sender and, with a user, the password.

Storage.title: Storage
Storage.description: Where the portal keeps images and how much the media library holds.
Storage.storeHelp: Images live in a private store and the site serves them through its own address, never exposing the store.
Storage.unreachableNotice: The store did not answer: new uploads fail until it is back. Check the server's configuration.
Storage.environmentNote: The store type and its credentials are set in the API's environment variables (STORAGE_DRIVER, S3_*), never in the panel.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: The text of the site's privacy page, in Portuguese and English. Each page of the site shows the edition of its language.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: The text of the site's terms of use page, in Portuguese and English. Each page of the site shows the edition of its language.

pt.label: Portuguese

en.label: English
